visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with large white-rimmed glasses and a white baseball cap with colorful dots speaks directly to the camera in a selfie-style shot. He is standing outdoors near a modern building with a dark glass facade. (2) He enters an indoor facility with bright fluorescent lighting. He stands in front of a white self-service kiosk with a touchscreen. The background shows a clean, white-walled room. (3) A refrigerator is shown, stocked with rows of 'Mai Xiang' black tea and milk tea boxes. The man reaches in to grab a drink. (4) The camera shifts to a large room filled with multiple automatic mahjong tables. Many young people are seated in groups, playing mahjong. The man walks between tables, gesturing and talking. (5) Close-up shots focus on the mahjong tiles—green, white, and pink sets. Hands move the tiles across the green felt surfaces of the automatic tables. (6) The man interacts with a specific group, reaching out to draw a tile from the table for a player. The players look on with mixed expressions of anticipation and amusement. (7) A man in a white t-shirt receives a red envelope from the main character. People in the background are blurred but appear to be clapping and smiling. (8) The main character returns to a selfie shot, concluding his talk while a digital map overlay appears on the screen showing a location in Zhonghe.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins at a fast pace with a bright tone. An upbeat electronic pop track with a synthesized bassline plays in the background. (2) Rapid mechanical clicking and percussive clacking sounds of mahjong tiles are heard consistently. The speaker's voice modulates between excitement and casual observation. (3) A distinct 'whoosh' sound effect marks a visual transition. Background chatter and laughter from a group are clearly audible but kept lower than the main narration. (4) A loud percussive 'thud' occurs as a tile is placed forcefully. The narrator's pitch rises during a humorous exchange. (5) Rhythmic applause and cheers break through the mix as the BGM maintains a steady, positive tempo. (6) The audio concludes with a final enthusiastic sign-off from the narrator over a slight swelling of the background music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for 'Qi Sheng,' a 24-hour self-service mahjong hall in Zhonghe. It uses an energetic narrator to highlight the facility's features—such as automatic tables, self-service kiosks, and unlimited drinks—while showcasing the social and competitive atmosphere of a mahjong tournament.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The narrator explicitly names the venue, demonstrates the payment process, highlights the amenities, and provides location information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines social media meme-style editing with a structured promotional walkthrough. The frequent sound of mahjong tiles provides a strong rhythmic anchor for the audio track.
